summary: The v42 exact bundle repairs the v41 findings by binding RuntimeStoragePolicyV5, a committed and role-separated immutable input transaction, a deterministic reservation invocation and attempt identity, a fixed raw-plus-manifest output payload with explicit sibling transaction paths, a supervisor-owned lease and filesystem write capability, same-open-FD input consumption and output finalization, default-deny write opcodes, and an exact CUDA, runtime, zero-fit and call-trace execution receipt feeding V3 pair and aggregate receipts. This registers design evidence only and authorizes no tests, implementation, replay, fitting, real-data access, PIT access, budget mutation or final-OOS access.
